detail.text: The warehouse operator must not manually enter the batch or serial number. "Warehouse operators do not enter batch or serial numbers manually." (P1)

Manual entry of the number from the label may only be performed by a shift lead, with a second person checking the entry against the label. "If a barcode cannot be scanned, the number may be entered manually only by a shift lead, with a second person checking the entry against the label (four-eyes check)." (P1)

Taking a photo and typing the number in yourself is not permitted for this operator: the standard allows manual entry only by a shift lead with a four-eyes check, and expressly forbids warehouse operators from entering batch or serial numbers manually; nothing in the standard authorises a photo-based alternative for operators.

If the material is serial-managed, each serial number must still be scanned individually; do not post with a quantity greater than the number of scanned serial numbers. "Every serial number must be scanned individually." (P2), "Do not post a serial-managed material with a quantity greater than the number of scanned serial numbers." (P2)

Before any posting, the supplier label must match the delivery note in material number, quantity and batch or serial number; if they do not match, do not post the goods receipt, move the handling unit to blocked area B-02 and inform the shift lead. "If the label and the delivery note do not match, do not post the goods receipt; move the handling unit to the blocked area B-02 and inform the shift lead." (P4)

If the material is batch-managed and no batch number is visible on the label, do not post the goods receipt; move the handling unit to blocked area B-02 and inform the shift lead. "Move the handling unit to the blocked area B-02 and inform the shift lead." (P5)

Since the operator cannot scan or manually enter the number, contact the shift lead for the situation so the shift lead can perform the manual entry with a four-eyes check, or handle any label problem under the blocking rules.

Shift lead involvement is required: manual entry of the number when the barcode will not scan is reserved to the shift lead, so the operator must escalate the unreadable barcode to the shift lead. "the number may be entered manually only by a shift lead" (P1)
